Abebook.description: Clarendon Paperbacks issue of Feeney's study of the role of the gods in the classical epic tradition, first published in 1991 and first issued in paperback by Oxford University Press in 1993. Trade paperback in the red pictorial wrappers; no dust jacket, as issued. The spine is creased from reading with light wear at the head, and the wrappers are lightly rubbed with a short crease and small nick at the head of the front panel. Scattered foxing to the fore-edge, a previous owner's name and date in ink on the half-title, and a previous reader's pencil brackets and marginal lines in the chapter on Ovid's Metamorphoses. Binding sound and the text complete and otherwise clean; includes bibliographical references and index.
